programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: S27 E3 — Cheltenham The team are in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire with DIY SOS going for Paralympic gold, to help build a home fit for a champion. 17-year-old Scott Jones is a young disabled athlete, who's already a world champion and is eager to be self-sufficient at home, but the house's current design is proving challenging.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: S18 E19 — Episode 19 Chef Rosheen Kaul sets the very first full Pressure Test of the season. The contestants must push through their limits as they face an intense three-hour challenge.
programme.title: MasterChef Australia

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Highway Hell The crew fight to restart a man's heart after he had a cardiac arrest and crashed the van he was driving. Elsewhere, a young woman is need of help following a series of severe stomach cramps.
programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.desc: S27 E5 — Eckington Nick Knowles, Laurence Llewellyn-Bowen and hundreds of Worcestershire volunteer builders rescue 17-year-old Antonia Payne-Cheney, who has been in hospital for the last three years. As a result of her complex condition, Antonia will remain in hospital until the necessary home adaptations have been made.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: S27 E6 — Rotherham When 36-year-old Terry Guest, father of two daughters, had a catastrophic brain injury, he was left with severe disabilities. The team and generous South Yorkshire volunteers and suppliers step in to adapt a home to make it more suitable for Terry.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
